+def test_named_text_wrapper_does_not_close_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="<first>", mode="w"
+    )
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="<second>", mode="w"
+    )
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.close()
+    second.write("second")
+    second.close()
+
+    assert not buffer.closed
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"firstsecond"
+
+
+def test_isolation_streams_remain_readable_after_cleanup(runner):
+    with runner.isolation() as streams:
+        sys.stdout.write("stdout")
+        sys.stderr.write("stderr")
+
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert streams[0].getvalue() == b"stdout"
+    assert streams[1].getvalue() == b"stderr"
+    assert streams[2].getvalue() == b"stdoutstderr"
+
